context_for_next_testing_agent: Execution Spine v1 module fully tested. Key endpoints: (1) GET /api/spine/dashboard - auto-syncs and returns full dashboard with needs_action, in_progress, ready_to_execute, recently_completed, held_back sections plus module_health and status_counts. (2) POST /api/spine/sync - force refresh from source modules. (3) GET /api/spine/tasks - list with optional filters (status, source_module, task_type). (4) POST /api/spine/tasks/{ref_id}/status - manual status update with logging. (5) POST /api/spine/tasks/{ref_id}/execute - trigger execution action (DO NOT test on ready pages - creates real WP drafts). (6) GET /api/spine/log - execution history. Status normalization: Page 'Approved' -> spine 'ready', intake session with all ready items -> 'ready'. Routing rules: page+ready -> 'Place in WordPress', intake_session+ready -> 'Export WooCommerce CSV', field_batch+ready -> 'Generate Destination Packs'. Frontend at /spine with nav item [data-testid='nav-execution-spine'].
